resources.string: Compare the real cost. Build the smarter basket.

Enter each product in its own box, then confirm they are like-for-like alternatives. ValuePilot compares exact package size and price facts on-device and refuses to rank when those facts are not safe enough.

Put the product name, package size and current price in the same box. To compare member prices, add a clearly labeled member price too. Use a concrete currency such as CA$ or US$ instead of a bare $. Blank lines inside a product are fine.

The standalone comparison above does not require Accessibility access. If you want experimental live capture from another shopping app, you can enable the optional scanner here.

ValuePilot uses Android Accessibility access only for its optional live-capture feature. It can read product or menu text in the app currently on screen and show the floating comparison panel. Off-screen collection and OCR remain user initiated. Parsing, ranking, the compact classifier and OCR run locally. This build has no INTERNET permission and does not upload screen contents, account credentials or shopping data.

Standalone comparison, deterministic parsing and exact value evaluation run on-device. This build has no INTERNET permission and does not send your product text, screen contents, credentials or shopping data to a server.

Product identity discovery uses an attributed, Canada-labelled Open Food Facts snapshot under ODbL-1.0. Source: https://world.openfoodfacts.org/ • licence: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/. It supplies names, aliases and barcodes for offline search only; it does not prove a current price, package quantity, store stock, store location or availability.
The bundled store directory uses a separately attributed OpenStreetMap snapshot under ODbL-1.0. Source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright • licence: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/. It contains source-listed GTA and Metro Vancouver locations only. A location row does not prove that a store carries an item, has stock, or has a current price.
Prices and comparisons you enter or confirm stay private on this device. They are personal observations, not live retailer offers. Home and Search cards are clearly labelled fictional demo data and must not be read as retailer data.
This build does not include an authorized current-offer feed. No flyer content is copied here. Source rights and attribution are reviewed before any future dataset is activated.

Automatically reads newly visible product and menu labels in the active app so ValuePilot can compare exact unit value and clearly labeled local estimates. It scrolls only when you explicitly choose off-screen collection; this build has no internet permission.
